from_source.notes: Jolt's CMake exports its ABI-affecting defines as PUBLIC compile definitions on the Jolt target, so consumers that link Jolt::Jolt get matching defines. OVERRIDE_CXX_FLAGS defaults ON and would replace the consumer's flags.

allocation.hook: Assign the global function pointers JPH::Allocate (void*(size_t)), JPH::Reallocate (void*(void* block, size_t old_size, size_t new_size)), JPH::Free (void(void*)), JPH::AlignedAllocate (void*(size_t size, size_t alignment)), JPH::AlignedFree (void(void*)). JPH::RegisterDefaultAllocator() installs Jolt's own.
allocation.install_constraint: Before JPH::Factory and JPH::RegisterTypes(), and before any other Jolt object is created. Unavailable when Jolt is built with DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR.
allocation.query: Read the same global function pointers back.

diagnostics.assert_hook: Runtime, only when built with asserts enabled (JPH_ENABLE_ASSERTS): assign JPH::AssertFailed (bool(const char* expression, const char* message, const char* file, uint line); return true to break).

jobs.job_model: Abstract JPH::JobSystem. Derive from JPH::JobSystemWithBarrier (which supplies barriers; call its Init(max_barriers)) and implement GetMaxConcurrency, CreateJob, QueueJob, QueueJobs and FreeJob. Jobs are reference counted: AddRef before handing a job to another thread, then Execute() and Release() it there. JobSystemThreadPool in Jolt/Core is the reference implementation of that pattern.
jobs.adapter: QueueJob/QueueJobs submit each job to the shared scheduler as a task that calls Execute() then Release(). PhysicsSystem::Update(dt, steps, temp_allocator, job_system) takes the adapter.

init_steps.step: assign JPH::Allocate and the other allocation hooks
create the job-system adapter over the shared scheduler

build_flags.self_check: JPH::VerifyJoltVersionID() returns false when the consumer's JPH_* defines differ from the library's; RegisterTypes() also checks and aborts.
